agent_explanation: Body 1 starts at 27.7 m/s, bounces, then collides with static body 0 at step 27. Collision transfers ~30.64 m/s to body 0 (mass 1 vs 4.9). Body 0 then moves toward right arena boundary. Even with 18 substeps per step, its displacement is not caught by arena boundary collision/positional correction, so at step 33 x=19.449 + r=0.801 =20.251 >20.15 limit (overshoot 0.251). Counterfactual lowering incident velocity prevents high post-collision speed and eliminates violation.
